sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.3861 of 2024
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondent Nos.1 to 3, learned Government Pleader for Irrigation and Command Area Development appearing for respondent No.4, learned Government Pleader for Finance and Planning appearing for the respondent No.5.
2.

This Writ Petition is filed seeking a writ of Mandamus to declare the action of the respondents in not depositing the compensation amounts to the petitioners as per Judgment and Decree of the Senior Civil Judge, Medak District, in L.A.O.P.No.10 of 2002, dated 27.11.2017 as arbitrary and illegal.

3. It is the case of the petitioners herein that the petitioners are the owners and possessors of their respective houses situated at Mantoor Village, Pulkal Mandal, Sangareddy District and their houses were SK,J acquired of submergence in Singoor Project in pursuance to the draft notification under Section 4(1) and draft declaration of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

Aggrieved by the compensation fixed by the Land Acquisition Officer, the petitioners filed L.A.O.P.No.10 of 2002 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, Medak District wherein the compensation was enhanced to Rs.8 per Sq. meter.

As the respondents failed to deposit the compensation amount, the petitioner filed E.P.No.21 of 2022 in L.A.O.P.No.10 of 2002 on the file of Senior Civil Judge, Medak District and the petitioners approached this Court by filing the present Writ Petition seeking a direction to the respondents to deposit the amount into the credit of E.P.No.21 of 2022 on the file Senior Civil Judge, Sangareddy,
Sangareddy District.

entities.text:
Senior Civil Judge, Sangareddy,
Sangareddy District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Having regard to the above backdrop of the case, this Court is of the considered view that the authorities cannot take their own time to deposit the enhanced compensation amount payable to the petitioners.

The inaction of the respondents in not paying the enhanced compensation SK,J amounts to the petitioners, who were already suffered by losing their houses and made them to suffer untold hardship and misery to run from pillar to post for getting the enhanced compensation,
for which they also incurred expenses.
Apart from that the petitioners have also to incur additional expenditure for approaching the Court for seeking the required relief.

With the raising inflation, the value of the money will also go down and the delayed payment of the enhanced compensation will result in the compensation amount itself losing all the charm and utility.

If the petitioners or similarly situated persons receive the enhanced compensation within the time, they will be in a position to use that amount in some other investments and would get some returns over the same.

6. Miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
4. Having regard to the above backdrop of the case, this Court is of the considered view that the authorities cannot take their own time to deposit the enhanced compensation amount payable to the petitioners.
The inaction of the respondents in not paying the enhanced compensation SK,J amounts to the petitioners, who were already suffered by losing their houses and made them to suffer untold hardship and misery to run from pillar to post for getting the enhanced compensation,
for which they also incurred expenses.
Apart from that the petitioners have also to incur additional expenditure for approaching the Court for seeking the required relief.
With the raising inflation, the value of the money will also go down and the delayed payment of the enhanced compensation will result in the compensation amount itself losing all the charm and utility.
opennyai_summary.decision:
If the petitioners or similarly situated persons receive the enhanced compensation within the time, they will be in a position to use that amount in some other investments and would get some returns over the same.
Having regard to the same, the Writ Petition is disposed of and the respondents are directed to deposit the amount in terms of the Order and Decree, dated 27.11.2017, passed in L.A.O.P.No.10 of 2002 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge, Medak District to the credit of SK,J E.P.No.21 of 2022 in L.A.O.P.No.10 of 2002 on the file of the Senior Civil Judge, Medak District, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate within a period of four (4) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
There shall be no order as to costs.
6. Miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
